jurisdiction: United States / Central Asia / Caspian region

claims.claim: Sanctions evasion risk can shift toward intermediary routing through Central Asia and Caspian trade corridors.

sources.name: OFAC Sanctions Programs and Country Information
supports: Provides official sanctions-program context and designation updates relevant to evasion-risk analysis.
limits: OFAC pages identify sanctions targets, not full trade-routing volumes.

sources.name: FATF Publications
supports: Provides official AML/CFT typologies and regional risk material useful for evasion-risk assessment.
limits: Broad typology material may not prove a specific corridor shift.

sources.name: UN Comtrade database
supports: Allows trade-flow checks for anomalies by product, partner, and route proxy.
limits: Trade data is lagged and aggregate; it does not prove intent or beneficial ownership.

unsupported_claims: Exact proportion of sanctions-evasion transactions routed through Central Asia or Caspian corridors.
source_plan: Check OFAC and EU designation records
Review FATF typologies and regional AML/CFT material
Analyze trade-flow anomalies with official trade databases
